title: Seismicity and ground displacement
missing: Panels 1A and 1C have no valid independent counterpart; existing routine-catalog plots are external context.
caption: Panel 1B is partial: original leveling through 2009 and daily GNSS through 2019, with a separate written December 2023 monitoring endpoint. The vertical datum is relative to March 1905; daily observations for 2020--2023 are missing.

title: Temporal evolution of seismicity
missing: Panels A and B require a multiyear calibrated, relocated catalog and magnitudes. Only nine provisional associations exist.
caption: Seismicity rates by region and depth versus time are not reproduced.

title: Spatial distribution of seismicity
missing: The map and both cross sections require independently calibrated and double-difference-relocated events. Provisional diagnostic locations are not substitutes.
caption: Map, northing-depth and easting-depth views are not reproduced.

title: Focal mechanisms of larger events
missing: Panels A and B require independent SKHASH/gCAP solutions and reliable locations. No focal inversion was executed.
caption: Ring-sector and central/onshore focal-mechanism maps are not reproduced.

title: Recorded station availability
caption: Partial: actual returned waveform intervals from 171 files and 26 station names. Short retrieved windows are marked without implying continuous coverage between them; channel-hours are not full network-years.

title: Station locations
caption: Partial: released station coordinates and retrieved IV/2I response metadata. Exact membership of the original 48 instruments, station epochs and the basemap are not fully reconciled.

title: Training examples
missing: Panels A--D require the specified training traces, annotations and augmentation examples. These were not reconstructed; downstream use of trained weights is not retraining.
caption: Noise, single-event and overlapping-event training examples are not reproduced.

title: PhaseNet benchmark examples
missing: Panels A and B were not generated for the exact CSOB swarm and CMIS noise examples. Other unlabeled inference comparisons remain diagnostics.
caption: The original benchmark examples and a labeled accuracy comparison are not reproduced.

title: Routine-catalog locations
missing: Current INGV routine-catalog plots are external context. The saved panel record contains no valid independent counterpart to these three views; the published selection/version is unresolved.
caption: Map and two cross sections retain their not-reproduced status; external catalog plots are documented separately.

title: Initial VELEST locations
missing: The map and both cross sections require scientific VELEST location and velocity/station-correction runs. Compilation alone did not produce these results.
caption: Initial-location map and cross sections are not reproduced.

title: Location uncertainties
missing: Panels A--G require independently selected regional subsets, HypoDD SVD locations and coordinate uncertainties. None of these scientific inversions ran.
caption: Regional locations, uncertainty-versus-count panels and uncertainty distributions are not reproduced.

title: Magnitude calibration and frequency distribution
missing: Panels A and B require qualifying relative-amplitude equations and calibrated magnitudes. Zero qualifying equations were obtained; completeness and b-value were not estimated.
caption: Local-versus-duration magnitude comparison and magnitude-frequency distribution are not reproduced.

title: Best-located earthquake subset
missing: All three views require independently relocated events and cross-correlation observation counts for the published quality filter. These outputs are absent.
caption: The filtered map and cross sections are not reproduced.

title: Seismicity by year
missing: The four annual groups for 2022--2025 require the independent multiyear relocated catalog. The available sample does not support them.
caption: All four annual groups are not reproduced.

title: Four major swarms
missing: The four swarm maps require the independent relocated catalog and justified swarm windows. These selections and locations remain incomplete.
caption: All four swarm maps are not reproduced.

title: Ring sectors and CPOZ common-receiver gathers
missing: Panels A--H require relocated sector selections and independently associated CPOZ P arrivals. The current associations contain zero CPOZ P arrivals.
caption: Sector views and six arrival-aligned waveform gathers are not reproduced.

title: Relocated seismicity on satellite imagery
missing: Panels A and B require reliable independent relocated coordinates and an appropriately sourced basemap. The relocated catalog does not exist.
caption: Full-caldera and onshore spatial views are not reproduced.

title: Hybrid-event clusters
missing: The three clusters and unclustered group require a multiyear scan, confirmed events, frequency indices and cluster-relative magnitudes. Four current candidates are unconfirmed.
caption: Cluster histories and annotated waveform collections are not reproduced.

title: Hybrid and shallow-event waveforms
missing: Panels A and B use different published events from the saved E1/E2 templates; D has no independently selected matching example. Those panels remain not reproduced.
caption: Panel C is partial: independently processed E3 CAAM/COLB observations. Onset alignment, display filtering and spectral settings differ or are incompletely specified. A, B and D have placeholders rather than substitute waveforms.
